additional_info.subject: Additional description:
additional_info.body:
Hello,
A client tried to charge today 5 of February around 4:50 PM CU TIME with an RFID Card but the screen showed "Impossible to authenticate. Try again later" On the charger events we can see that the alarms
"CU not reachable" and "CU up again"
alternated repeatedly. We rebooted the charger but the problem occurred again.
Can you please check the logs?
Thank you
software version
: v8.0.5-0-g33a6c1d+APN

additional_info.subject: ID0476812-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313508370048] Check on logs CRM:02681001395
additional_info.body:
Hello Rosita, good morning.
My colleague's analysis is correct, the OCPP connection was not up and that is the reason why the customer couldn't start charging.
The 2nd photo is not entirely correct as it's part of the boot up sequence of the charger after you performed the reboot.
We cannot understand what is the root cause since the problem is no longer live, we will proceed to close the ticket.
If you can, next time, please leave the charger with OCPP offline so that we can analyse why it's not working. I will teach the colleagues how to collect this information and tell them to reboot if necessary to bring it back.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
